question: For what purpose should the wise one use the mantra named brahmārpaṇa?
premises: The mantra named brahmārpaṇa is used
The wise one is the agent
The purpose is cutting all actions
inference: The wise one should use the brahmārpaṇa mantra for the cutting of all actions.
